goal: DEPTH: sub-sections / config sections in real integration with the backend — raise real coverage and capability levels

depth_targets.title: Access keys (the ARM listKeys action)
limitations: Keys are fixed simulator values, not real random key material, and Vyomi does not verify SharedKey request signatures against them.

depth_targets.title: Configuration (performance, secure transfer, TLS, access tier, replication SKU, …)
limitations: Every field round-trips through ARM exactly as written, but nothing is enforced by the Blob data plane: HTTPS-only, TLS version, Entra-only auth and shared-key-access toggles do not change what a request can do.

depth_targets.title: Redundancy (replication SKU)
limitations: The SKU name round-trips through ARM; Vyomi stores data once, locally — there is no secondary region, no geo-replication and no customer-managed failover.

depth_targets.title: Networking (public network access / firewall default action / routing preference)
limitations: publicNetworkAccess, networkAcls and routingPreference round-trip through ARM, but the Blob data plane never enforces them — a request from a 'denied' network still succeeds. Virtual network rules, IP firewall rules and private endpoints are not simulated.

depth_targets.title: Encryption (key source)
limitations: The encryption.keySource flag round-trips through ARM for display only; every account is encrypted the same way underneath. Customer-managed keys, encryption scopes and infrastructure (double) encryption are not simulated.

depth_targets.title: Data protection (soft delete, point-in-time restore, versioning, change feed) over the blobServices/default ARM sub-resource
limitations: deleteRetentionPolicy, containerDeleteRetentionPolicy, restorePolicy, isVersioningEnabled and changeFeed round-trip through ARM exactly as configured, but core/azure_blob_core.py does not enforce any of them: deleted blobs/containers are not recoverable, there are no blob versions, and there is no change feed to read. Operational backup, permanent-delete and file-share soft delete are not simulated.

depth_targets.title: Activity log
limitations: Only console/SDK-triggered mutations made since the simulation booted are recorded (no historical backfill); severity/category filtering and the 6-hours/30/90-day timespan picker are not modelled, and 'caller' is a fixed placeholder identity rather than the real signed-in principal.

depth_targets.title: Queues (create, list, delete) and messages (send, receive, peek, delete) over the Azure Storage Queue REST data plane
limitations: core/azure_queue_core.py keeps one global queue namespace per Nano instance (the same simplification the Key Vault keys/secrets stores make) — queues are not isolated per storage account, so two accounts share the same queue list.

depth_targets.title: Diagnose and solve problems
limitations: A guided troubleshooting wizard backed by Azure's own telemetry and knowledge base — there is no equivalent diagnostic corpus in Vyomi.

depth_targets.title: Access control (IAM) scoped to a storage account
limitations: Vyomi's RBAC simulation (core/azure_iam_core.py) is not wired to a per-resource scope check from this console; role assignments, deny assignments and the 'Check access' simulator are not rendered here.

depth_targets.title: Data migration (AzCopy / Data Box / migration tooling)
limitations: A separate migration toolchain and, for Data Box, physical hardware shipped by Microsoft — outside what a local simulator can run.

depth_targets.title: Events (Event Grid subscriptions on storage events)
limitations: Storage-account-sourced Event Grid event subscriptions are not wired from this console; core/azure_eventgrid_core.py models Event Grid topics, not storage-account system events.

depth_targets.title: Storage Mover
limitations: A separate Azure product (Microsoft.StorageMover) for migrating file shares from on-premises servers — not modelled by any Vyomi core.

depth_targets.title: Partner solutions
limitations: Third-party marketplace integrations (e.g. Cloudian, DataDynamics) — third-party identity and billing Vyomi cannot run.

depth_targets.title: File shares (Azure Files)
limitations: Azure Files is a distinct SMB/NFS data plane (account.file.core.windows.net) with no core in this repo yet — not yet implemented.

depth_targets.title: Table storage
limitations: core/azure_table_core.py models table create/list/delete and entity insert/get/query/replace/merge/delete over the native OData/JSON wire, in ONE global namespace per Nano instance (the same simplification Queues makes — tables are not isolated per storage account). $filter supports only `Field eq 'value'` terms joined by `and`; batch/transaction (EntityGroupTransaction), continuation-token paging and complex OData queries are not simulated.

depth_targets.title: Front Door and CDN
limitations: A separate edge/CDN product fronting the storage endpoint — outside a local simulator's network topology.

depth_targets.title: Shared access signature (SAS) generation
limitations: The form builds a structurally correct SAS query string (sv/ss/srt/sp/st/se/spr/sig) from the selected options and signs it with the account's listKeys value, but core/azure_blob_core.py and core/azure_queue_core.py do not verify any request signature (SharedKey or SAS) — the generated token is not a real, checkable credential.

depth_targets.title: Microsoft Defender for Cloud
limitations: A separate security product (threat detection, vulnerability scanning) with its own billing plan — not modelled by any Vyomi core.

depth_targets.title: Object replication
limitations: Requires a second storage account and cross-account async replication; Vyomi stores each account's blobs independently with nothing to replicate between them.

depth_targets.title: Blob inventory
limitations: A scheduled background job that writes an inventory report blob — Vyomi has no job scheduler wired to the Blob core.

depth_targets.title: Lifecycle management policies
limitations: Enforced, but lazily: core/azure_blob_core.py re-evaluates every enabled rule's prefixMatch filter against blob age on each list/get (not a daily background job) and applies the most aggressive matching baseBlob action (delete > tierToArchive > tierToCool), setting a real x-ms-access-tier / <AccessTier> or removing the blob. blobTypes beyond blockBlob, snapshot/version actions and the 'days after last access/creation' trigger variants are not modelled.

depth_targets.title: Azure AI Search (index this storage account)
limitations: A separate Azure product (search indexing + a query engine) — not modelled by any Vyomi core.

depth_targets.title: Data Lake Gen2 upgrade
limitations: A one-way, backend-run upgrade of the account's namespace flag plus a full-container metadata rewrite — there is no equivalent background migration job in Vyomi.

depth_targets.title: Resource sharing (CORS) rules
limitations: Enforced for the Blob service only: core/azure_blob_core.py answers an OPTIONS preflight against the configured corsRules, denying (403 CorsPreflightFailure) any Origin/method/header combination that matches no rule and 200ing with real Access-Control-* headers for one that does. File/Queue/Table service CORS are honest gaps — Set/Get Service Properties isn't implemented on those data planes.

depth_targets.title: Advisor recommendations
limitations: Azure Advisor's recommendations come from analysing real usage telemetry and cost data across Microsoft's fleet — there is no equivalent analytics pipeline in Vyomi.

depth_targets.title: Insights (storage account metrics dashboards)
limitations: Azure Monitor metrics (capacity, transactions, latency) are not emitted by core/azure_blob_core.py or core/azure_queue_core.py.

depth_targets.title: Alerts
limitations: Alert rules fire against Azure Monitor metrics the storage data planes do not emit.

depth_targets.title: Metrics
limitations: Azure Monitor metrics (capacity, transactions, latency, availability) are not emitted by the storage data planes.

depth_targets.title: Workbooks
limitations: Workbooks visualize Azure Monitor log/metric queries the storage data planes do not emit.

depth_targets.title: Diagnostic settings
limitations: Diagnostic settings forward platform logs/metrics to a Log Analytics workspace or Event Hub — the storage data planes do not emit platform logs to forward.

depth_targets.title: Logs (Log Analytics queries over storage diagnostics)
limitations: Depends on diagnostic settings forwarding to a Log Analytics workspace, which is not simulated (see azure.storage.diagnostics).

depth_targets.title: Tasks (Azure Automation runbooks)
limitations: Azure Automation runbook execution is a separate product with its own worker fleet — not modelled by any Vyomi core.

depth_targets.title: Support + Troubleshooting
limitations: Opens a real Microsoft support ticket workflow — outside what a local simulator can run.
